note: First entry of the Erlang migration corpus (hyperbeam/src/core/include/lbry_test_keys.hrl, ?LBRY_CHANNEL_KEYS). `erlangJwk` is the VERBATIM output of `lbry_channel_key:pem_to_jwk(Pem)` captured by running the Erlang module (rebar3 shell), so the JS importer can be checked field-for-field against what the proven import->sign path actually consumes -- not just the private scalar. `scalarHex` is the same key's private scalar for a human-readable byte-for-byte check.
